usedFor: Discord holds your community and Sangam CRM holds sales, so “Watch Guild Members” can open a deal with “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “Watch Guild Members” in Discord, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new member is a possible buyer, and the action sets custom fields and a next follow-up date.

watchOut: “Watch Guild Members” is polling, so “Create Opportunity” starts after a scheduled check, once for every new member.
